name: Proxmox VE
description: Register a Proxmox VE host or cluster and give agents scoped, human-approved access to its nodes, VMs and LXC containers through an mcp__cockpit-proxmox__* server. The plugin talks to the Proxmox REST API itself and keeps the API token — an agent never gets it. Connecting asks for consent once (reads are free after that), and every change (start/stop/shutdown/reboot/snapshot) asks afresh with the literal action shown and is never remembered. Rolling back a snapshot and deleting a VM or LXC container are off until you turn them on. Self-signed certificates are trusted only after you confirm the shown fingerprint in the plugin settings.
author: Cockpit
